d.ko: Assemble your robot squad, construct their AI and send them in the battle arena to see your strategy play out. Iterate, improve and repeat until you outsmart all your opponents and friends online.
d.en: Assemble your robot squad, construct their AI and send them in the battle arena to see your strategy play out. Iterate, improve and repeat until you outsmart all your opponents and friends online.
d.zh: AI竞技场 - 为你的机器人小队编制AI，让他们征战竞技场。不断改进，优化，反复打磨…或许你就能完爆对手并从在线的好友组中脱颖而出。
